title: Verify Office can see sensitive vendor fields (Credit Terms, Credit Limit, Taxes)
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Office role. (sensitive vendor fields are gated by Manage AP/AR per spec v33; Office has Manage AP/AR ON).
At least one vendor exists with credit terms/limit and tax values set.
steps:
1. Click Vendors and open a vendor.
2. Look at the vendor's Overview card.
3. Open the vendor's Edit view and look for Credit Terms, Credit Limit, and Taxes.
expected: Credit Terms, Credit Limit, and Taxes are VISIBLE to Office in both the Overview card and the Edit view. (Known failure SV-8133 was raised when they were hidden - retest.)
